venue: The Underground Theater at MGM Grand
address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: Category A
zones.description: Category A is the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot / Our Pick for Tape Face: closest to the stage, with the clearest view of facial expressions, props and the small physical details that drive the show.

zones.label: Category B
zones.description: Category B sits through the middle of the room and is the strongest value balance when you want a clear overall view without paying for the closest section.

zones.label: Category C
zones.description: Category C is the rear value section. The Underground is compact enough that you still get the full visual-comedy picture from farther back.
